hints.content: A dilation by a scale factor of $4$ will map $B'$ to a point $4$ times as far from the origin as point $B$ was, but in the same direction.

Point $B$ is $\purpleC{1}$ unit right and $\maroonD{1}$ unit up from the origin.

The image $B'$ will be $4(\purpleC{1})=4$ units right and $4(\maroonD{1})=4$ units up from the origin.
